company.shortDescription: Slingshot Startup Accelerator is a Rocket Hatch program.
company.description:
Slingshot is an initiative of Rocket Hatch, the Alabama Center for Sustainable Energy and Fortnum Capital Partners, with the goal to promote the success of high-growth IMPACT startups in the Southeast.  These organizations bring together expertise in startup acceleration, clean tech and IMPACT investment and an unparalleled network of entrepreneurs, industry experts and investors that are passionate about making the world a better place through profitable ventures.

In addition, Slingshot has established strategic relations with key organizations including the Cleantech Open Accelerator and Alabama Launchpad which bring to bear additional acceleration resources and access to non-dilutive funding opportunities for their startups.
